resizeSidebar: Drag to resize · double-click to reset
cmBypassHint: When on, file writes and commands run without per-step approval (careful).
cmWelcomeReady: Describe a coding task — it reads code, edits files and runs commands to do it.
cmWelcomePick: Open a workspace folder to start.
cmPlaceholder: Give it a coding task — Enter to send…
cmPlaceholderMod: Give it a coding task — ⌘/Ctrl+Enter to send…
cmAllowlistHint: Commands starting with these prefixes run without approval. "Always allow" in the dialog is session-only; this list is permanent.
cmThinkHint: Reasoning depth: Off is fastest; Deep is more thorough but slower. Reasoning is shown.
cmMaxStepsHint: How many tool steps a Code-mode turn may take before pausing. Reply "continue" to resume. Raise it for complex tasks.
cmBashTimeoutHint: Default timeout for bash commands. Raise it for slow test/build steps.
cmDirAskHint: If allowed, this directory stays accessible for the session (shown in the header, revocable anytime). If denied, the model will try another way.
cmSudoTitle: High risk: run a command with sudo
cmSudoHint: This runs with administrator privileges — it can affect your whole system and is outside the workspace sandbox. Allow only if you're sure it's safe.
cmSudoPwNote: Used locally only: piped straight to sudo, never shown, logged, saved to history, or sent to the model. Leave blank if your system is passwordless.
cmGrantAddTip: Allow this session to access another folder outside the workspace
cmTempHint: Sampling temperature for each agent step. Lower = steadier and more reproducible (default 0.3); higher = more creative but less predictable.
cmThinkBudgetHint: Hard per-step ceiling on thinking tokens. Over budget the think block closes gracefully: the reasoning stays in context and the model acts on it — nothing discarded, coherence kept. 0 = no ceiling (the per-step generation limit still bounds it). For models that loop in thought at low temperature, 1000-2000 works well.
cmMaxTokensHint: Generation cap per agent step. 0 = auto by think depth (off 4096 / normal 6144 / deep 8192); any value is clamped to the context window. Lower it to bound runaways, raise it for long reasoning and big file writes.
cmAutoEditsHint: Write/edit steps run without asking (commands still need approval). Checkpoints let you roll back anytime.
chatCollapseCodeHint: Long code blocks fold to a header + preview; click to expand.
cmAutoReadOnlyHint: Obviously read-only commands (ls, grep, git log) run without asking; anything that writes, deletes, or is uncertain still asks.
cmHeadlessHint: Browser tools run headless with no visible window. Applies the next time the browser starts; logins are kept.
cmRewindHint: Rewind to before this message (restores edited files, removes later messages)
cmRewindConfirm: Rewind to before this message? All files the agent wrote/edited after this point will be restored and later messages removed. (bash side effects can't be undone)
cmQueuePlaceholder: Working — messages queue up and run after this turn…
cmBgKillHint: Click to kill all background jobs
cmBgKillConfirm: Kill all {n} background jobs (e.g. dev servers the agent started)?
cmEg1: Explain this project's structure and key flows
cmEg2: Run the tests and fix every failure
cmEg3: Review the code and list likely bugs
cmSkillPromptPh: Prompt template — inserted into the composer when invoked…
cmSkillsHint: Reusable task templates. Type / in the Code composer to invoke, e.g. /review.
cmMcpHint: Connect MCP servers to bring external tools to the coding agent: a command (stdio) or an https:// URL (streamable HTTP). Unless marked trusted, every call needs your approval; results are always treated as untrusted content.
cmMemoryHint: Let the agent save non-obvious findings future sessions need into <workspace>/.chaty/memory/ (plain markdown, human-editable, never leaves the machine); the index rides into context at the start of a new session. Off = no index loaded and no memory tool offered.
cmMcpStoreHint: Every entry is version-pinned, permission-transparent, and live-certified against DARIA's client (cargo store_cert). Once added, manage it in the list above.
cmSkillFilesHint: A skill is a markdown file of steps. The prompt carries only one line per skill (name + when); the body loads via use_skill only when needed — so skills cost almost no context. Put them in ~/.chaty/skills/ (global) or <project>/.chaty/skills/ (project, shadows global). Below are the ones bundled with DARIA; each can be turned off.
canvasFolderHint: Saved canvas versions live on disk as JSON. Open the folder to browse older files.
imageGenHint: On-device Z-Image-Turbo via Apple MLX. Image gen has two modes: the chat model writes the prompt, or you write it yourself (Tools → Image gen, or click the chip). `/image your prompt` always sends your text straight to the generator. The engine stays unloaded until you generate, and turning the mode off frees the memory.
imageGenQuantHint: 4-bit fits 16–18 GB Macs (~7 GB). 8-bit is the balanced default (~12 GB). Full quality wants 40 GB+ (~21 GB). Suggested for this Mac: {n}-bit.
imageGenSizeHint: Square output. Smaller sizes use less memory and finish faster.
imageGenStepsHint: Turbo is distilled for 8–9 steps. More steps rarely help and cost time.
imageGenSeedHint: Leave empty for a random seed each time. Click a seed under a generated image to reuse it.
imageGenSeedApplied: Seed {seed} is set for the next image.
imageGenFolderHint: Every image is saved as a PNG. Open the folder to browse or copy them.
inputPhImageTool: Ask for a picture — the model writes the prompt…
imageGenUnsupported: Image generation needs an Apple Silicon Mac (M1 or later).
imageGenNeedPython: Image generation needs Python 3.10+ on this Mac. Install it from python.org, then try again.
imageGenConfirm: The first time, DARIA downloads the MLX engine and the {size} GB Z-Image-Turbo weights from Hugging Face. Nothing is sent to a generation API — only the download itself leaves this machine. The engine stays unloaded until you generate, and turning Image gen off frees the memory.
imageGenPrivacy: First use downloads weights from Hugging Face. Generation itself stays on this Mac.
cmdkImageDirect: Image gen: write the prompt myself
cmdkImageAsk: Image gen: let the model write the prompt
aboutTagline: Discrete AI for Reasoning, Interaction & Automation — local and private
cmWelcomeNoModel: Load a model from the titlebar to start coding.
cmRunInterrupted: **The last run was interrupted** — the interface reloaded while it was working (a renderer crash or restart), so that turn never finished. Edits already written are still in the workspace; say "continue" to pick it up.
emptyNoRoom: **(Nothing was generated this turn: the prompt no longer fits the model's context window. Start a new conversation, or raise Settings → Model → Context length.)**
emptyOutOfBudget: **(The model was still reasoning when it ran out of generation length, so no answer was written. Raise Settings → Sampling → Max length, or regenerate.)**
emptyThoughtOnly: **(The model spent this turn reasoning and stopped without writing an answer. Regenerating usually gets one.)**
noModelsFound: No models in the models folder
canvasEditModeHint: Patch: the model emits search/replace blocks — fast, but needs verbatim echoes. Rewrite: the model streams the full HTML and the system diffs it live — the reliable choice for smaller models.
canvasDragHint: Drag to resize · double-click to reset
canvasComposerEditing: Hand-editing — save or cancel to keep iterating
canvasSelPrefix: Modify ONLY these selected elements; keep everything else unchanged:
canvasSelHint: {n} element(s) selected — the edit targets them
canvasEditCodeHint: Hand-edit this version's code; saves as a new version
canvasConsoleEmpty: No console output for this version
canvasResetHint: Drop every iteration and return to the first version
canvasResetConfirm: All iterations of this canvas will be discarded, keeping only the first version. This cannot be undone.
canvasScanWaiting: Model is thinking — edits start shortly…
canvasNoDiff: The first version has nothing to compare
canvasInspectHint: When on: hover/click an element in the preview to jump to its code line; click a code line to flash its element.
canvasHealMsg: The page threw an error — let the model fix it?
canvasNoHtml: Couldn't parse HTML from the output
confirmDeleteModel: Permanently delete the model file "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
readyMsg: Ready — everything runs locally, nothing leaves your machine.
loadToStart: Load a local model to start chatting.
inputPh: Message… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline)
inputPhMod: Message… (⌘/Ctrl+Enter to send, Enter for newline)
webDesignOn: Web design mode: on (/webdesign to toggle)
webDesignOff: Web design mode: off (/webdesign to toggle)
inputPhDesign: Describe the UI you want — get a single-file HTML…
effortHint: This model has native reasoning-effort levels: low is faster, high is more thorough (the model's own default).
thinkAuto: Thinking is auto-managed by this model (Qwen3.5+); no manual switch
forkTitle: Branch into a new chat from here
visionAttach: Image · the model will see it
cmAttachImage: Attach an image for the model to see
mlxBadgeTip: MLX folder model — runs on the Apple-Silicon-native engine
storeSearchPh: Search models, or paste a repo link and press Enter…
storePickModel: Pick a model on the left to see details
storeOverRam: ≈ Near or over memory — may run slowly
storeMlxMacOnly: MLX models are macOS (Apple Silicon) only — pick a GGUF build instead
mmprojFailed: The vision encoder failed to load — text only this session (images fall back to OCR).
dlVisionPair: Vision model: the vision encoder (mmproj) will be downloaded too
dlHint: Enter a HuggingFace repo (owner/name) or URL to list its model files (GGUF / MLX) and download into your models folder.
systemPromptPh: Optional, e.g. You are a concise, professional assistant.
personalityHint: Built-in personalities fill the system prompt. Click again to clear. You can still save your own below.
gpuCrashCapped: The GPU driver crashed the app during a previous model load, so this one runs with fewer layers on the GPU ({a}/{b}) — slower, but stable. The next load that survives restores full offload; if it keeps crashing, update your GPU driver.
specDecodeHint: The model's own prediction head guesses the next few tokens and the model checks them in one pass — same reply, fewer passes. How much it helps depends on the model and on what is being written. Changes apply on the next model load.
specDecodeUnsupported: The loaded model carries no prediction head, so there is nothing to speculate with.
ragTopKHint: Raise it for a large library or questions that span files; lower it on a small context window.
tipRagTopK: How many knowledge-base excerpts one question may cite. More covers more of the library and costs more context.
gpuHint: Auto fills the GPU with as many layers as VRAM allows. Changes apply on the next model load.
ctxHint: Auto = as much of the model's trained context as memory allows. Custom values are also capped to fit memory.
confirmClearChats: Delete all conversations? This cannot be undone.
dataHint: All conversations, models and indexes live in the local data folder — copy it to back up.
clearChatsHint: Deletes every conversation and Code session. Irreversible.
clearKbHint: Removes all indexed documents and vectors; original files are untouched.
clearKbConfirm: Clear the knowledge base? All indexed documents will be removed.
setCodeThemeHint: Palette for code blocks in answers
setSendKeyHint: With the combo, Enter inserts a newline
setReduceMotionHint: Disable UI transitions and pop-in animations
confirmClearErrorLog: Clear the error log? Everything recorded so far is deleted; new errors are still recorded afterwards.
errorLogHint: App errors are recorded to chaty-error.log automatically. Please attach it when filing an issue — it speeds up diagnosis a lot.
setAutoTitleHint: Generate a title after the first reply
setAutoLoadLastHint: Restore the previously used model at startup
modelsFolderHint: Drop GGUF files or MLX model folders here to make them available
modelsDirHintToast: Drop model files into this folder, then reopen the model picker to see them
hfEndpointHint: Model search, downloads and the knowledge-base model all use this endpoint. hf-mirror.com is recommended in mainland China; mirrors lack the xet fallback — switch back to Official if a file fails.
tipHfEndpoint: Switch to a path-compatible mirror when huggingface.co is unreachable
voicePreviewHint: Play a sample with the current engine, voice and adjustments
voiceEngineHint: Whisper handles speech recognition locally. Read-aloud can use Kokoro (offline) or Microsoft Edge TTS (online English neural voices). Live voice chat always uses Kokoro.
kbModelNote: First use downloads the multilingual bge-m3 embedding model (~730 MB, one-time; fully offline after).
kbEmpty: No documents yet — add a PDF / text / image file
kbFolderEmpty: No importable files were found in that folder (or its subfolders).
kbFolderConfirm: Found {n} files in that folder and its subfolders. Import all of them?
kbScopeHint: Check the documents to search; unchecked ones are excluded from answers.
kbClearConfirm: Clear the entire knowledge base? All indexed documents will be removed (the embedding model is kept). This can't be undone.
kbReportPh: Enter a report topic or question — grounded only in your KB docs, e.g. summarize the key terms and risks across these contracts
kbReportEmpty: Generating an overview report from your knowledge base…
kbReportRunning: Generating a report from your knowledge base (cited per file, fully offline)
kbReportNeedModel: Load a chat model first, then generate the knowledge-base report.
podcastSub: Two hosts · English · from your knowledge base
podcastIntro: From your enabled documents, the model writes a two-host English script, then Kokoro reads it aloud with alternating male/female voices. Other LLM features are locked while it runs; you can cancel anytime, then play and export the audio. (English podcast only.)
podcastNoScript: Could not produce a usable script — try again or switch models
podcastFootZh: Tip: the podcast is in English — useful for listening practice.
kbNeedSetup: Download the embedding model and add documents first
drSub: Multi-round web search + reasoning → an in-depth, cited report
drTopicPh: Enter a topic, e.g. the state of solid-state batteries and commercialization outlook
drEmpty: Give a topic; the model searches the web over several rounds, reasons as it goes, and writes a cited in-depth report you can export to PDF.
setupStoreLink: Want other community models? Browse the model store
setupFoot: Sized & quantized for your memory, downloaded from HuggingFace into the app's models folder.
tipTemperature: Randomness: lower = more deterministic, higher = more creative (0.7 is typical)
tipTopP: Nucleus sampling: choose only from tokens within the top-P cumulative probability
tipTopK: Consider only the K most likely tokens; 0 disables the limit
tipMinP: Drop tokens whose probability is below P× the top token's; 0 disables
tipRepeatPenalty: >1 discourages repetition; too high hurts fluency
tipMaxTokens: Max tokens per reply; with no limit, the context window is the bound
tipStopSeqs: Generation stops immediately when the model emits any of these strings
tipGpuAccel: How many layers run on the GPU; Auto fills as many as memory allows
tipCtxLength: How much conversation the model can hold (tokens); larger uses more memory
oomPartial: Low VRAM — GPU offload reduced to {a}/{b} layers
oomCpu: Low VRAM — fell back to CPU
ctxClamped: Context auto-fitted to {n} (weights + KV cache must fit in unified memory)
oomFail: Out of memory — couldn't load this model. Try a smaller / more-quantized model, or free up RAM.
gpuCrashCpu: The GPU driver crashed the app during the last model load — running on CPU this time (slower but stable). Update your GPU driver to try GPU again.
conversionSuspect: This model family has known compatibility issues with the bundled engine (conversion metadata or engine version lag) — replies may degenerate into blanks or noise. On macOS use the model's MLX build (works well); GGUF support awaits an engine upgrade.
visionConfigMissing: This model folder is missing its image-processor configuration (preprocessor_config.json), so vision is disabled and the model was loaded text-only. Restore that file from the official model repo and reload to re-enable vision.
chatSaveFailed: Saving this conversation failed — it will not survive a restart. Check disk space and permissions.
todayNote: Today is {date}. When the question refers to "today/recent/now", use this date.
webInstruction: Below is information retrieved from the web, numbered 【1】【2】…. Use it to answer the user's question in natural prose, and append the matching citation marker(s) — e.g. 【1】 or 【1】【3】 — at the end of each sentence that draws on a source. If the material is insufficient, say so.
ragInstruction: Below are passages retrieved from the user's local knowledge base, numbered 【1】【2】…. Answer STRICTLY from these passages: state only what they explicitly support, never invent facts or numbers beyond them; if they do not contain the answer, you must say the current documents do not mention it. Append the matching citation marker(s) — e.g. 【1】 or 【1】【3】 — at the end of each sentence that draws on a passage.
attachInstruction: The user uploaded a file "{name}". Its content is below; base your answer on it:
samplingPresetHint: A starting point from common model families. Sliders stay editable — pick one, then tweak. Reload the model so the next reply uses the new values.
ttsEngineHint: Kokoro is offline English (read-aloud and Live chat). Edge TTS is online Microsoft neural voices — English voices only, used for read-aloud. Live voice chat always stays on Kokoro.
ttsEdgePrivacyWarn: Warning: Microsoft Edge TTS is an online service, not offline. Text you read aloud is sent to Microsoft's servers and may be logged or processed off this machine. Only use it if you accept that privacy trade-off.
tipPitch: Raise or lower speaking pitch. Edge TTS only — Kokoro has no pitch control.
tipVolume: Raise or lower speaking volume. Edge TTS only — Kokoro has no volume control.
edgeVoiceFailed: Could not list Edge voices — check your network.
suggest1: Explain quantum entanglement in simple terms
suggest2: Write a polite, professional time-off request email
suggest3: Implement quicksort in Python and explain the idea
crashBody: DARIA hit an unexpected error. Your conversations are safe on disk.
